profile.name: 树莓派 GPIO 软件 SPI 接口
profile.name_en: Raspberry Pi GPIO Software SPI Interface
profile.description: 基于树莓派 GPIO 引脚实现的软件 SPI 通信接口，通过位操作模拟 SPI 总线与外部器件交换数据。适合实验室原型开发、嵌入式测试和自动化装置中连接 SPI 传感器、模数/数模转换器及其他低速 SPI 外设。
profile.description_en: A software-implemented SPI communication interface using Raspberry Pi GPIO pins to emulate an SPI bus by bit-banging. It is suitable for laboratory prototyping, embedded testing, and automation setups that connect SPI sensors, ADC/DAC devices, and other low-speed SPI peripherals.
